context: Judge final artifacts only, including response.json. Do not infer an unobserved process or award credit for promises. Compare preservation against supplied fixtures. Paths are relative to workspace/.

checklist.name: version-ordering
checklist.description: The calendar index Current line identifies the incoming organizer update with the newer DTSTAMP at equal SEQUENCE, using its new event start date and correct UTC week-ending destination. It does not keep the earlier version designated current.

checklist.name: native-history
checklist.description: The earlier native invitation remains unchanged at its original path and the incoming payload remains unchanged both in its filed native record and in preserved inbox-original evidence. No YAML is inserted into either invitation.

checklist.name: version-navigation
checklist.description: The existing calendar index links to both versions with meaningful current/historical descriptions. All those links resolve to the intended native records; the earlier event is not moved just to share a folder with the update.
